Master '''Hightower''' is the owner of the ferry in the town of [[Taren Ferry]].

== Appearance ==
He has a narrow face and pointed features. He is compared to a ferret and a weasel. 

== Activities ==
For a large sum of money, he transports [[Moiraine]], [[Lan]], [[Thom]], [[Rand]], [[Mat]], [[Perrin]], [[Egwene]] and all of their horses across the river in the middle of the night, aiding them in their flight from the [[shadowspawn]] that attacked [[Emond's Field]] on [[Winternight]].

[[Nynaeve]] forces him to row her across the Taren in a row boat as she attempts to catch up to the boys and Egwene that have been spirited away by Moiraine. {{ref/book|1|15}}

It is unknown if Master Hightower survived the [[Trolloc]] attack on Taren Ferry that preceded the [[Battle of Emond's Field]].

== In the television series ==
In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]], {{TVlink|Master Hightower}} is played by {{TVlink|Pearce Quigley}}.
